title: The Hidden 50% Drop in AI Agents Following Your Rules
description:
Every coding agent harness reads your AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files differently, and that changes with every model release. Baz co-founder and CEO Guy Eisenkot shares data from millions of AI code reviews showing steering-file usage fell by 50% almost overnight, and what actually makes a coding agent harness follow your instructions.

What we cover:
– Why a 50% drop in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md usage went almost unnoticed
– What actually makes a coding agent harness follow your instructions
– Why CodeRabbit's structured rule set outlasts a plain CLAUDE.md file
– What's trending in Tessl's own skills registry, and why code review skills dominate it
– Why specs, verification, and merge tactics are replacing agile rituals on agent-era teams
